revision_summary: Three quote-matching issues need targeted fixes on rerun: (1) trajectory_verdict.grounded_examples[0] cites ts 01:32 for 'again, it was five years' but that phrase actually lands around 01:37-01:39, immediately after the slate-roof line — correct the timestamp and quote it as a standalone fragment rather than merged with 'So,'. (2) cherry_pick_moments[2] stitches customer dialogue from 00:58, 01:08, and 01:15 into one continuous quote attributed to 00:58 — the underlying claim (customer states a cost objection with a self-supplied monthly figure) is real and in the transcript, but Stage 3 should either cite the range (00:58-01:15) or break it into separately-timestamped quotes rather than presenting a fused quote as verbatim at a single ts. (3) cherry_pick_moments[3] similarly fuses three lines from 01:39-01:46 under a single 01:39 citation — same fix, cite as a range or split quotes. None of these are fabrications of substance (the words exist in the transcript) but the presentation violates verbatim-quote discipline and should be corrected. Additionally, soften the 'textbook objection_inversion' framing in cherry_pick_moments[2]/objections[1]/coaching_focus[1] — the customer preemptively rejects the exact flip being proposed by pointing out the loan payment equals his current bill, so this is a harder recovery case than Stage 3's language implies, not a clean textbook setup. Finally, consider adding the customer's cordial sign-off ('Roger that, thanks for listening') to the state_changes/trajectory narrative — the ending isn't as purely cold/disengaged as the current 'adversarial -> disengaged/closed' delta suggests.
